base: Using the attached photo of this exact dog as the likeness reference (keep her round fluffy head shape, long drop ears, dark eyes, button nose and happy tongue-out expression recognizable), create a professional brand-quality logo artwork of her HEAD ONLY for a premium apparel brand. Pure black on a flat pure white background, no gray, no gradients, no texture, no shadow, no frame, no collar, no body below the neck. Generous empty margin on every side, art centered and symmetric-feeling. All lines and shapes BOLD: minimum stroke about 3% of the image width so it stays readable at 4 inches and on a black shirt when inverted to white. Confident, deliberate, original graphic design (not generic clip art, not a photo filter, not an AI portrait). Crisp vector-like edges. Absolutely no text, letters, signature or watermark.

styles.prompt: Style: pure solid black silhouette of the head and ears with eyes, nose and tongue carved out as white negative space, iconic, front-facing.
Style: solid black circle badge with the dog head carved out as white negative space, the fluffy head breaking slightly out of the circle at the top, front-facing.
Style: bold high-contrast stencil, solid black shapes and white negative space define fur masses, eyes and ears, crisp vinyl-cut decal, front-facing.
Style: cut-paper stencil with bold white stencil bridges separating solid black shapes, graphic and industrial, front-facing.
